title: 第113章 唐逸成了所有人的灾难！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 孔诗岚还在震惊中，她完全没想到唐逸竟然说在这么短的时间，写了两首！原本能写一首，已经足够离谱的了，现在他竟然说写了两首。也难怪全场会喷他，那些成名几十年的大儒都做不到的事，他这么短的时间能做到，这说出去谁信？直到唐逸将两张纸递到了面前，孔诗岚才从错愕中回过神。她目光下意识落在唐逸的诗词上。然而，只看一眼，孔诗岚整个人便呆住了，一双灵动清澈的美眸，这时候也一点点瞪大，那张倾城绝世的脸上，更是充满了震惊和震撼！但她很快回过神，立即抽出了第二张纸。动作紧张而急促。等目光落在第二张纸的诗词上后，孔诗岚猛地抬起头，美眸盯着唐逸，但却是一句话都说不出来。场中，所有人都盯着孔诗岚的一举一动，见到她呆滞的样子，众人都认为猜测得到证实，肯定是唐逸写得太垃圾，她都没脸念出来了。看着这一幕，炎文帝也都紧张得冒冷汗了，在阁楼中的公主萧澜，更是已经急得直跺脚了。“哈哈，我就说吧，这家伙浪得虚名而已。”“哼，狂妄过头了，现在知道好歹了吧！”“小诗仙？真以为陛下承认这名头，你就无敌了？可笑！”“……”场中，嘲讽声一浪浪席卷开。听着这些嘲讽声，唐画看向唐逸的目光顿时充满怜悯，看来不用我出手，今日这些人就能将你给生撕了。秦钰眉头微皱，难道大炎名动京都的小诗仙，真是名不副实？“孔小姐，你不必给唐逸面子，他今日这般无礼，身败名裂也是他咎由自取！”姜云娜忍不住了，直接站出来大声说道。唐逸让她颜面尽失，她要亲手让唐逸万劫不复。唐逸原本不是太在意周围人的议论，这点小场面和前世的尸山血海比起来，什么屁！心境，早就练出来了。只是现在听到姜云娜的诋毁，他还是有点忍不住了：“草，没完没了了是吧？说你是白莲花，还说错你了？”“还有，谁告诉你孔诗岚不说话，是因为我写得不好？”“有没有一种可能，是因为我写得太好了，让她震惊得说不出话来？”钗头凤，在后世那就是陆游和唐婉的双绝唱，影响了几百上千年呢。老子总不能抄都抄不好吧？这不是开玩笑么！“噫~”然而，听到他的话，众人都在嘘他，没人相信。这时，震惊中孔诗岚终于回过神。“不，唐少爷说得没错，我的确是被震惊到说不出话来了。”饶是孔诗岚性子清冷，这时候也是俏脸激动，扬起手中的诗词道：“唐少所写的这两首词，绝对是陆将军和唐小姐这段凄美爱情的真实写照！”“我原本让写的是唐小姐给陆将军敬酒时，陆将军当时的心境，但唐少爷太厉害了，竟然将唐小姐当时的心境也写出来了！”“而且写得非常好，无论哪一首，绝对都是传世神作！”听到孔诗岚的话，整个鹿鸣湖顿时安静了下来。唐画，唐敬，颜霜玉，姜云娜……所有人的脸色都僵住了，脸上都是错愕和难以置信。什么？唐逸真在这么短的时间内，写出了两首绝世诗词？这怎么可能？那些文坛大儒都做不到的事，他竟然能做到？“孔……孔小姐，你是不是误会了？”姜云娜脸色狰狞，死死盯着台上的孔诗岚：“我不信，你将他写的诗词念出来，他就是个废物，怎么可能写出两首传世神作？”她是要将唐逸送进地狱，让唐逸万劫不复的，而不是又一次成为唐逸的垫脚石，成为全场的笑话！众人闻言，都齐齐看向孔诗岚。连同炎文帝，唐敬，唐画等人也都看向孔诗岚。然而，孔诗岚却看都没看他们，美眸看了一眼唐逸，道：“好，既然如此，那我便将唐逸所写的两首词，给念一下吧！”“第一首，《钗头凤·红酥手》。”“红酥手，黄縢酒，满城春色宫墙柳。东风恶，欢情薄。一怀愁绪，几年离索。错，错，错！”“春如旧，人空瘦，泪痕红浥鲛绡透。桃花落，闲池阁。山盟虽在，锦书难托。莫，莫，莫！”孔诗岚清冷的声音传遍全场。而随着她的声音传开，众人的脸色渐渐变了。从开始的不屑不信，渐渐变得震惊，而后瞪大双眼，到最后很多人的嘴巴都张得大大的，能吞下他们自己的拳头。红酥手，黄縢酒，满城春色宫墙柳……短短三句，写尽了曾经的美好。东风恶，欢情薄……笔锋一转，激愤悲情的气息瞬间扑面而来，写尽了陆将军离异后的痛苦。整首词节奏急促，声情凄紧，荡气回肠！顷刻间，整个鹿鸣湖上静悄悄，所有人都震惊无比，瞠目结舌。原本还以为唐逸是在吹牛，是在装逼，那么短的时间怎么可能写得出什么诗词？结果，唐逸就是写出来了，刚才他们的质疑，他们的嘲讽，现在都成了打在他们脸上的巴掌。那么短的时间又如何？别人做不到，他唐逸做得到。这，就是他小诗仙的本事！吧嗒……唐敬手中的茶杯掉在了地上，整张脸都僵硬下来，连瞳孔都在放大。不可能，这绝对不可能，唐逸……唐逸怎么可能能写出这种意境的诗词？他连女人都没经历过，他怎么可能写得出来？颜霜玉出身寒微，诗词懂得不多，但看到身边那一张张呆滞的脸，她也知道唐逸写了一首了不得的诗词。这怎么可能？她这些年一直在严加防范，根本就不给唐逸接触书籍的机会。他，怎么可能懂这些东西？姜云娜一双眼睛已经瞪如牛眼，死死地盯着唐逸，像是想要将他看穿一般。颜霜玉不知道诗词好坏，但她自幼读书，赏析诗词的本事还是有的，自然知道这是一首绝世神作。难怪孔诗岚刚才会震惊，可是唐逸怎么能写得出这种好词？明明画哥哥说了，他就是个废物，就是个阴险狡诈的小人啊！唐画也是目瞪口呆，此时他的手都在轻微颤抖，心头已经被恐惧吞噬了。他想要拖延时间，故意将唐逸推出来挡灾争取更多的时间。却没想到唐逸却成了他们的灾难！而且还是难以跨越的天灾！
content_en:
Kong Shilan was still in shock. She didn't expect Tang Yi to say that he had written two songs in such a short period of time. It was outrageous enough that he could write one song, but now he actually said he had written two. It’s no wonder that everyone in the audience is criticizing him. He can do things in such a short time that even great scholars who have been famous for decades cannot do. Who would believe it? It wasn't until Tang Yi handed two pieces of paper in front of him that Kong Shilan recovered from his shock. Her eyes subconsciously fell on Tang Yi's poems. However, after just one glance, Kong Shilan was stunned. Her beautiful, clear eyes widened little by little, and her alluring face was filled with shock and shock. But she quickly came to her senses and immediately pulled out the second piece of paper. The movements are tense and rapid. After his eyes fell on the poems on the second piece of paper, Kong Shilan suddenly raised his head, staring at Tang Yi with his beautiful eyes, but he couldn't say a word. Everyone in the field stared at Kong Shilan's every move. Seeing her dull look, everyone thought that their guess was confirmed. Tang Yi must have written so rubbish that she was too embarrassed to read it out. Looking at this scene, Emperor Yanwen was so nervous that he broke into a cold sweat, and the princess Xiao Lan in the attic was already stamping her feet anxiously. "Haha, let me tell you, this guy just lived up to his reputation." "Humph, he was too arrogant. Now you know what's good." "Little Shixian. I really thought that your majesty would be invincible if he admitted this title. Ridiculous." "..." Waves of ridicule swept through the venue.
Listening to these taunts, Tang Hua looked at Tang Yi and his eyes were filled with pity. It seems that these people can tear you alive today without me taking action. Qin Yu frowned slightly. Could it be that Dayan's reputation as a little poetry fairy in Kyoto really didn't live up to his reputation. "Miss Kong, you don't have to give Tang Yi face. He is so rude today and it is his own fault for his ruined reputation." Jiang Yunna couldn't help it anymore and stood up and said loudly. Tang Yi had made her lose face, and she wanted to make Tang Yi irrecoverable with her own hands. Tang Yi originally didn't care too much about the comments of the people around him. Compared with the mountains of corpses and seas of blood in his previous life, this small scene was nothing. The state of mind has long been cultivated. But now that he heard Jiang Yunna's slander, he still couldn't help it: "Fuck, it's endless, isn't it? When I called you White Lotus, I was wrong about you." "Also, who told you that Kong Shilan didn't speak because I didn't write well." "Is there a possibility that it was because I wrote so well that she was shocked and speechless." Chaitou Feng, in later generations, was the double swan song of Lu You and Tang Wan, which influenced hundreds of thousands of years. I can't copy it, it won't be good. Isn't this a joke? "Hey~" However, when they heard his words, everyone booed him, no one believed it. At this time, Kong Shilan finally recovered from the shock. "No, Master Tang is right. I was indeed shocked and speechless." Even though Kong Shilan had a cold temperament, her pretty face was excited at this time. She raised the poem in her hand and said: "The two poems written by Master Tang are definitely a true portrayal of the poignant love between General Lu and Miss Tang.
"I was originally asked to write about General Lu's state of mind when Miss Tang toasted General Lu, but Master Tang was so awesome that he even wrote down Miss Tang's state of mind at that time." "And it's very well written. No matter which song it is, it's definitely a masterpiece that will be handed down from generation to generation." "Hearing Kong Shilan's words, the entire Luming Lake suddenly became quiet. Tang Hua, Tang Jing, Yan Shuangyu, Jiang Yunna... everyone's faces froze, with shock and disbelief on their faces. What? Tang Yizhen wrote two peerless poems in such a short period of time. How is this possible? He can actually do things that the great scholars in the literary world cannot do. "Kong... Miss Kong, have you misunderstood. "Jiang Yunna's face was ferocious as she stared at Kong Shilan on the stage: "I don't believe it. If you read out the poems he wrote, he is just a loser. How could he write two masterpieces that will be handed down from generation to generation. "She wanted to send Tang Yi to hell and make Tang Yi irrecoverable, instead of becoming Tang Yi's stepping stone again and becoming the joke of the whole audience. When everyone heard this, they all looked at Kong Shilan. Together with Emperor Yanwen, Tang Yi Jing, Tang Hua and others also looked at Kong Shilan. However, Kong Shilan didn't even look at them. She glanced at Tang Yi and said, "Okay, in that case, let me read the two poems written by Tang Yi. ""The first song, "The Hairpin-headed Phoenix·Hongsu Hands". "Red hands, yellow wine, the city is full of spring scenery and willows on the palace walls." The east wind is evil and happiness is thin. With a heavy heart, I have been away for a few years. Wrong, wrong, wrong. "Spring is as old as ever, people are thin and empty, and the tears are red and wet through the gauze." Peach blossoms fall, Xianchi Pavilion
Although the mountain alliance is there, it is difficult to trust the brocade book. Mo, mo, mo. "Kong Shilan's cold voice spread throughout the audience. As her voice spread, everyone's expressions gradually changed. From disdain and disbelief at the beginning, they gradually became shocked, then widened their eyes, and finally many people's mouths were so wide that they could swallow their own fists. Red hands, yellow wine, spring scenery and willows all over the city... In just three sentences, all the memories of the past were written. Beautiful. The east wind is evil, the joy is weak... With a turn of the pen, an aura of anger and sadness came to my face, describing General Lu's pain after divorce. The whole poem was fast-paced, with a sad voice, and it was heart-wrenching. For a moment, the whole Luming Lake was silent, and everyone was shocked and dumbfounded. How could he write any poems? In the end, their doubts and ridicules were now slaps in their faces. What others couldn't do, Tang Yi could do it. Bang... Tang Jing dropped the tea cup in his hand, and his whole face became stiff. Come on, even the pupils are dilating. Impossible, this is absolutely impossible, Tang Yi... How could Tang Yi write a poem with this kind of mood? He had never even experienced a woman, how could he write it. Yan Shuangyu came from a humble background and didn't know much about poetry, but seeing the dull faces around her, she knew that Tang Yi had written an amazing poem.
She has been taking strict precautions over the years and never gave Tang Yi the opportunity to come into contact with books. How could he possibly understand these things. Jiang Yunna's eyes were as wide as a bull's eye, staring at Tang Yi, as if she wanted to see through him. Yan Shuangyu didn't know whether the poems were good or bad, but she had been reading since she was a child and had the ability to appreciate poems, so she naturally knew that this was a masterpiece. No wonder Kong Shilan was shocked just now, but how could Tang Yi write such good words. Mingming Hua brother said that he is a waste, a cunning and cunning villain. Tang Hua was also stunned. At this time, his hands were trembling slightly and his heart was swallowed by fear. He wanted to delay time and deliberately pushed Tang Yi out to block the disaster to buy more time. But they didn't expect that Tang Yi would become their disaster. And it’s an insurmountable natural disaster
title_en: Chapter 113 Tang Yi became everyone’s disaster!
